# Synthflow

Skills that teach agents to work with Synthflow. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [SynthFlowAI/AnthropicPlugin](https://github.com/SynthFlowAI/AnthropicPlugin), at commit `205871e`.

Connects Claude Code to the Synthflow AI voice-agent platform through its hosted MCP server, with skills for reviewing calls and auditing agent prompts, plus a docs-search connector.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Synthflow**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Synthflow**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install synthflow@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

2 skills: `call-review`, `prompt-review`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs
